turns.text: I assumed CPA refers to Cost Per Acquisition / Booking (Cost per conversion: €124.84), and also provided Cost Per Lead (€42.07). In September 2026, the CPA (cost per booking / conversion) on the **search** channel was **€124.84**, based on **€3,870.00** in total ad spend across **31** bookings (with a cost per lead of **€42.07** over **92** leads).

args.sql:
WITH search_campaigns AS
  (SELECT campaign_id,
          channel,
          name
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_kcmax.campaigns`
   WHERE LOWER(channel) = 'search' ),
     spend_agg AS
  (SELECT SUM(s.spend) AS total_spend_eur
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_kcmax.ad_spend` AS s
   JOIN search_campaigns AS c ON s.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   WHERE s.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' ),
     bookings_agg AS
  (SELECT COUNT(b.booking_id) AS total_bookings
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_kcmax.bookings` AS b
   JOIN search_campaigns AS c ON b.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   WHERE b.booked_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' ),
     leads_agg AS
  (SELECT COUNT(l.lead_id) AS total_leads
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_kcmax.leads` AS l
   JOIN search_campaigns AS c ON l.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   WHERE l.created_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' )
SELECT s.total_spend_eur,
       b.total_bookings,
       l.total_leads,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(s.total_spend_eur, b.total_bookings), 2) AS cost_per_booking_eur,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(s.total_spend_eur, l.total_leads), 2) AS cost_per_lead_eur
FROM spend_agg s
CROSS JOIN bookings_agg b
CROSS JOIN leads_agg l;

turns.text: The win rate (lead-to-booking rate) for search leads created in September 2026 was **33.70%**, with **31** out of **92** leads converting into bookings.

args.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.lead_id) AS total_leads,
       COUNT(DISTINCT b.booking_id) AS total_bookings,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
                          WHEN b.booking_id IS NOT NULL THEN l.lead_id
                      END) AS converted_leads,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
                                            WHEN b.booking_id IS NOT NULL THEN l.lead_id
                                        END), COUNT(DISTINCT l.lead_id)) * 100, 2) AS win_rate_percentage
FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_kcmax.leads` AS l
INNER JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_kcmax.campaigns` AS c ON l.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
LEFT JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_kcmax.bookings` AS b ON l.lead_id = b.lead_id
AND DATE_DIFF(b.booked_date, l.created_date, DAY) BETWEEN 0 AND 30
WHERE LOWER(c.channel) = 'search'
  AND l.created_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'

turns.text: In the last fiscal quarter (Fiscal Q3 2026: 1 August 2026 to 31 October 2026), there were **217** total orders, including cancelled orders.

args.sql:
WITH fiscal_context AS
  (SELECT fiscal_quarter,
          MIN(date_day) AS start_date,
          MAX(date_day) AS end_date
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.semantic.time_spine`
   WHERE fiscal_quarter =
       (SELECT fiscal_quarter
        FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.semantic.time_spine`
        WHERE date_day = DATE '2026-11-10' )
   GROUP BY fiscal_quarter),
     previous_fiscal_quarter AS
  (SELECT MAX(date_day) AS last_day_of_prev_fq,

     (SELECT fiscal_quarter
      FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.semantic.time_spine`
      WHERE date_day = DATE_SUB(
                                  (SELECT start_date
                                   FROM fiscal_context), INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS prev_fiscal_quarter
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.semantic.time_spine`
   WHERE fiscal_quarter =
       (SELECT fiscal_quarter
        FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.semantic.time_spine`
        WHERE date_day = DATE_SUB(
                                    (SELECT start_date
                                     FROM fiscal_context), INTERVAL 1 DAY) ) ),
     prev_fq_bounds AS
  (SELECT fiscal_quarter,
          MIN(date_day) AS start_date,
          MAX(date_day) AS end_date
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.semantic.time_spine`
   WHERE fiscal_quarter =
       (SELECT prev_fiscal_quarter
        FROM previous_fiscal_quarter)
   GROUP BY fiscal_quarter)
SELECT bounds.fiscal_quarter AS fiscal_quarter_start,
       bounds.start_date,
       bounds.end_date,
       COUNT(orders.order_id) AS total_orders
FROM prev_fq_bounds AS bounds
LEFT JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_kcmax.orders` AS orders ON orders.order_date BETWEEN bounds.start_date AND bounds.end_date
GROUP BY bounds.fiscal_quarter,
         bounds.start_date,
         bounds.end_date;

turns.text: I assumed Fiscal Year 2026 runs from 1 February 2026 to 31 January 2027, making the YTD period 2026-02-01 through 2026-10-06. Net revenue is calculated as gross revenue from non-cancelled orders minus partner returns. As of the end of 6 October 2026, the fiscal year-to-date net revenue is **€19,521.84** (gross revenue of **€19,611.59** minus **€89.75** in returns).

args.sql:
SELECT SUM(o.amount) AS gross_revenue_eur,
       COALESCE(SUM(r.amount), 0) AS returns_eur,
       SUM(o.amount) - COALESCE(SUM(r.amount), 0) AS net_revenue_eur
FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_kcmax.orders` AS o
LEFT JOIN
  (SELECT order_id,
          SUM(amount) AS amount
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_kcmax.returns`
   GROUP BY order_id) AS r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-02-01' AND '2026-10-06'
  AND o.status <> 'cancelled'

turns.text: Revenue on Thursday, 24 September 2026 was **€542.00**, representing an increase of **21.12%** compared to **€447.50** on Thursday, 17 September 2026.

args.sql:
WITH daily_rev AS
  (SELECT order_date,
          SUM(amount) AS revenue
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_kcmax.orders`
   WHERE status <> 'cancelled'
     AND order_date IN ('2026-09-17',
                        '2026-09-24')
   GROUP BY order_date)
SELECT r_curr.revenue AS revenue_current_day,
       r_prev.revenue AS revenue_previous_week,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(r_curr.revenue - r_prev.revenue, r_prev.revenue) * 100, 2) AS pct_change
FROM
  (SELECT revenue
   FROM daily_rev
   WHERE order_date = '2026-09-24') r_curr
CROSS JOIN
  (SELECT revenue
   FROM daily_rev
   WHERE order_date = '2026-09-17') r_prev

turns.text: I defined a week as Monday through Sunday and evaluated performance across gross revenue, net revenue (gross minus partner returns), and CRM booking value. The best week between Monday, August 17 and Sunday, September 27, 2026 was the week of **September 21 to September 27, 2026**, leading across all primary financial metrics: - **Net Revenue:** **€3,372.25** (Gross Revenue: **€3,387.25** minus Returns: **€15.00** across 26 orders) - **CRM Booking Value:** **€33,300.00** (across 13 bookings) ### Weekly Performance Breakdown - The final week (**2026-09-21 to 2026-09-27**) recorded the peak for both net shop revenue (**€3,372.25**) and CRM booking value (**€33,300.00**). - The lowest performing week for order revenue was **2026-08-17 to 2026-08-23** (€2,141.25), whereas CRM bookings reached their lowest in the week of **2026-08-31 to 2026-09-06** (€22,900.00).

args.sql:
WITH weekly_orders AS
  (SELECT DATE_TRUNC(order_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start,
          SUM(CASE
                  WHEN status != 'cancelled' THEN amount
                  ELSE 0
              END) AS gross_revenue_eur,
          COUNT(CASE
                    WHEN status != 'cancelled' THEN order_id
                END) AS order_count
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_kcmax.orders`
   WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-17' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
   GROUP BY 1),
     weekly_returns AS
  (SELECT DATE_TRUNC(order_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start,
          SUM(amount) AS returns_eur
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_kcmax.returns`
   WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-17' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
   GROUP BY 1),
     weekly_bookings AS
  (SELECT DATE_TRUNC(booked_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start,
          SUM(amount) AS booking_value_eur,
          COUNT(booking_id) AS booking_count
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_kcmax.bookings`
   WHERE booked_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-17' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
   GROUP BY 1)
SELECT o.week_start,
       DATE_ADD(o.week_start, INTERVAL 6 DAY) AS week_end,
       COALESCE(o.gross_revenue_eur, 0) AS gross_revenue_eur,
       COALESCE(r.returns_eur, 0) AS returns_eur,
       COALESCE(o.gross_revenue_eur, 0) - COALESCE(r.returns_eur, 0) AS net_revenue_eur,
       COALESCE(b.booking_value_eur, 0) AS booking_value_eur,
       COALESCE(b.booking_count, 0) AS booking_count,
       COALESCE(o.order_count, 0) AS order_count
FROM weekly_orders o
FULL OUTER JOIN weekly_returns r USING (week_start)
FULL OUTER JOIN weekly_bookings b USING (week_start)
ORDER BY week_start ASC
